method: Playwright Chromium against the live local Dashboard, measuring dashboard data readiness, First Contentful Paint, first decoded video frame, asset SHA-256, and screen response behavior.

before_revision.source: Previous accepted live premium Hero validation immediately before map removal.

after_revision.source: Final live Playwright run on the revised asset; video decoded, played, and wrapped at the native loop boundary.

comparison.interpretation: The revised video is nearly the same size as its previous local version. The Dashboard remains usable and paints before the video frame; data readiness and paint timings remain in the same range. These are individual local runs and vary with cache and machine load.

preload_strategy: preload=none; source attached lazily only when the Dashboard is active and reduced-motion preference is not enabled. A local opening-scene poster is displayed before playback.
